caveats: A comeback is counted only where FDA records a resubmission link, so every comeback rate is a floor.
Counting notices double-counts substances: one substance in eight is abandoned, not one in six.
The other-door join is 59% precise before hand-checking. Both sides are free-text chemical names; every candidate was read and the rejections are recorded in other_door.py with reasons.

Substance categories are inferred from the notice's own name and are ours, not FDA's. 14% of notices match more than one rule and the first wins, which moves category sizes but not the -0.65 slope (stable from -0.68 to -0.53 across 200 random rule orders).
The pre-2008 cohorts are thin: 5, 11 and 15 withdrawals. The pooled pre-2010 figure (n=47) is the evidence.
The third fate of a withdrawn substance - sold on an undisclosed self-determination - is not observable from any FDA file by construction.
